app.title: Cohort Coach
app.tagline: Know what your class gets wrong, then fix it.
status.offline_forced: Offline mode is on for the demo
banner.simulated: Simulated data: this class and these children are made up for the demo.
role.later: This screen is built in a later step. For now, use the teacher screens.
judge.title: Judge mode
judge.intro: A five-minute tour. No login. Everything marked simulated is made up.
judge.step1: Load a simulated class of 28 children.
judge.step2: Open Home and read the one next action.
judge.step3: Open Enter check and try the keypad for one child.
judge.step4: Open My class and read the cards. They show how many children, as counts.
judge.step5: Switch the language to Hindi or Tamil.
judge.step6: Turn on offline mode and open My class again.
judge.advanced: Term 2 has started for the simulated class.
judge.later: Pretty versions of these two come with the Practice Class screen.

check.form: Which paper did the children write?
